closed-update-refused-by-the-node-tasks.text: Closed update refused by the node: tasks.

The story, requirements and rulings are in the specification; decisions, shape and hosted checks are in the plan; the files this work may change are in the touch list; the frozen gate is on the gate page.

slice-the-negative-host-refuses-a-closed.text: Slice: the negative host refuses a closed-datum update on the node.

[x] host-follows-the-registry-mode: the dispatch module exports the two mode readers; each of the host's five handlers reads the mode inside its command and resolves the registry against the mode's code; an unreadable mode runs as open; the node-free handler controls still end in exit status 10 against an unreachable provider.

[x] closed-update-part-added: the discovery table, the runner's part list and the judge's expectations carry closed-update; the part creates with --closed (preview and create), registers and folds a key with the executable, and submits the controller's honest update through the host with no local evaluation.

[x] closed-update-judged-against-closed-datums-pin: the part requires the create receipt to name open_datum.closed_datum, the recorded pin to equal the closed preview's pin and differ from the open preview's pin of the same seed, and the node's refusal to name that pin in the application spending role with exit status 11 and an equal read before and after.
[x] closed-update-control-is-a-termination: the same registry's key is terminated and folded with the executable, accepted by the node, and reads as terminal.
[x] part-lists-agree: the node-free membership control lists fourteen names and fails when one is missing; the comments that carried the count no longer carry it.

[x] closed-update-accepted-mutant-added: the patch replaces the closed spend's update arm and nothing else; its row names the flip, the control pair and the rule label; the runner's hygiene accepts it; the self-check job runs the no-patch control for it in an added step.
[x] existing-parts-and-mutants-unchanged: the thirteen parts and the eight mutants keep their result on the hosted head.
[x] docs-name-the-part-and-the-mutant: the page names the part and the mutant and the counts they change.
[x] pages-and-speech-stamped: every changed page carries current speech, and the site page its clips.
[x] local-legs-green: the cheap local commands in the plan pass on the final head, and the new part passes once locally on the final candidate.
